title: Encoding the sharpness function
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers with $k<n-1$. Let $P=\{i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}:i<k+1\}$ and let $T$ be its complement among the $n$ coordinates. The binary encoding of the sign function formed by multiplying the parity on $P$ by the decoded monomial on $T$ equals the sum in $\mathbb F_2$ of the coordinate sum on $P$ and the monomial on $T$.
